label: D1 reward signal after rewarded trial, scaled by D1 policy logit, boosted after a1 S2 r
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(choice + 1, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(choice, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(choice - 1, 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
explanation: Fires only at D1, and essentially only when the previous trial was rewarded (near zero after unrewarded trials, zero at GO/D2). Within rewarded D1 steps, magnitude is a piecewise-linear (non-monotone) function of the model policy logit choice = logit(a1)-logit(a2) at that step: fitted slopes about +0.45 from -1 to 0, -1.3 from 0 to 1, +0.7 above 1, so it is largest when the policy leans strongly to a1. Previous trial a1 -> S2 (rare) rewarded adds about +1.3 on top; a1 S1 r adds little once choice is included. Trial-before reward, since_rev, value and stay added <0.02. Uses an internal model quantity (choice) but no future variables. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.68, test 0.67 (all-cue ceiling 0.57; reward x last-trial only ~0.21).

issues: The claimed non-monotone shape over choice (+0.45 from -1 to 0, -1.3 from 0 to 1, +0.7 above 1) comes from where the knots were placed, not from the data. Adding knots at choice -1 and 2 to the original terms (8 terms) changes the slopes to about +0.14 below -1, ~0 from -1 to 0, -0.14 from 0 to 1, -0.47 from 1 to 2 and +0.80 above 2. Test R^2 rises from 0.67 to 0.76. With knots at 2, 3 and 4 the feature is flat until choice is about 3, then rises at roughly 1.1 per logit unit (test 0.81). The 'dip between 0 and 1' is not real.

Systematic error on unrewarded D1 steps. Misses on the original terms over-predict every D1-after-unrewarded cell by about 0.2 to 0.27 (a2 S1 u -0.270, a1 S1 u -0.263, a2 S2 u -0.263, a1 S2 u -0.200). The original terms cannot pull those steps to zero. Adding the single term (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==0) removes the error and raises test R^2 from 0.666 to 0.725.

The a1 S2 r boost is real (dropping it costs about 0.09: 0.666 -> 0.573) but it is not purely additive. An a1 S2 r x max(choice-2,0) interaction gets weight +1.37 and helps on test, so the rare-rewarded-a1 boost grows with the a1 lean.

The worst-fit windows still show large under-predictions (actual 2.5 to 3.3, predicted -0.6 to 0.8) on rewarded D1 steps, often decaying over consecutive rewarded trials. The terms do not capture this. Previous-state, good-state, early-episode and value variants each add <=0.003 once the unrewarded term is in.
Claims that check out: active only at D1, ~0 at GO and D2 and after unrewarded trials. Trial-before reward and value add little (<=0.005). No future variables are used.
skeptic.revised_label: D1 reward signal after a rewarded trial: about flat for most policy values, then rising steeply once the D1 policy leans strongly to a1 (logit(a1)-logit(a2) > ~3). Extra boost after a rewarded a1 -> S2 (rare) trial that grows with the a1 lean. Zero after unrewarded trials and at GO/D2.
